title: Set or change?
instruction: For each moment in the game, pick the block that fits.

items.text: Start of the game: the score starts from zero
items.why: Whatever was there, it should be 0. That’s setting.

items.text: The player picked up a coin
items.why: One more point is added to the ones they already have.

items.text: The character ran into an enemy
items.why: One life is taken from the ones it has: change by -1.

items.text: A new level starts again with three lives
items.why: The value is overwritten with 3, no matter how many were left.

items.text: Combo: one point more for each coin in a row
items.why: The points are added to what is already there.

items.text: The player pressed “Play again” and the mode is “playing” again
items.why: The mode is overwritten with a new value.

debrief: Set overwrites the value, change adds to what is there. Set belongs at the start of the game, change belongs to catching a coin.
